title: Privilege escalation via unfiltered role restoration in project backup import
vulnerabilityInformation: A privilege escalation vulnerability was discovered in project backup import functionality. When restoring access-control teams from backup files, roles carrying global site-wide permissions were not validated and could be attached to project-scoped teams without proper filtering. This allowed users with limited backup import privileges to gain unauthorized site-wide permissions. Additionally, a separate issue in the permissions collection logic failed to exclude project-scoped team memberships when determining global permissions, allowing the escalated privileges to take effect across the entire site. The vulnerability was confirmed through multiple reproduction tests demonstrating that low-privilege users could obtain administrative capabilities after importing a crafted backup file.
